selection: Checkpoint and joint candidate selection by mean validation log loss only; include training-prior control.
split_policy: Preserve all existing 600-family 60/20/20 assignments; no generation or split changes. Reject cross-split family or exact feature overlap.
scaling: Fit standardization per node/feature on training rows only. LKR monetary fields stay LKR before this ordinary training transform.
serving: Dependency GAT is an explicitly exploratory comparator; preserve primary XGBoost and rule-based health. Disclose validation-selected control even when it beats intended dependencies.
limitations: Synthetic LKR estimates and simulated labels, not observed event outcomes.
Fixed functional topology, not CAD adjacency or causal risk propagation.
Previously inspected test split; exploratory comparison, not a pristine holdout.
Single seed; no calibrated real-world probabilities or unseen-venue evidence.
Derived planning totals can dominate graph structure; compare self-only, shuffled, prior and simple-rule controls.
